text: Testing plays a vital role in software development. Unit tests check small pieces of code, like individual functions, to ensure they work correctly in isolation. Integration tests then verify that different parts of the system work well together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write a failing test first, then write the minimum code to pass it, and finally improve the code. This approach helps prevent bugs early. Tests also give programmers confidence. When making changes or adding new features, they can run the existing tests to quickly see if anything breaks, making the whole process safer and more reliable.
